text:
anita: Heads-up — there's a firewall rollout scheduled tonight 22:00 UTC that defaults to deny outbound from the infra subnet (10.200.0.0/16). I'm concerned GPU nodes in usw2 will lose egress to KMS and fail disk decryption on boot. Can we pause the rollout until we confirm KMS is whitelisted?

ryan: which PR/changeset is this? link?

security-oncall: PR #5123 — changes the default egress policy on the infra firewall to `deny` and adds allowlist entries only for a handful of management IPs. KMS FQDNs aren't included.

anita: exact breakout: GPU warm pool and new nodes use regional KMS endpoints via our NAT GW. If egress to kms.us-west-2.amazonaws.com is blocked nodes can't unwrap volume keys -> boot fails and node doesn't join the cluster.

kevin: If nodes can't reach KMS you see errors like `AccessDeniedException` or `KMS key not found` during cloud-init and then repeated volume attach/decrypt loops. We've seen this in staging once.

sre-ops-bot: ALERT: 2024-11-09T21:40:44Z — 12 pending gpu nodes in cluster-usw2 reporting decrypt failures during last trial. Sample log: ```Nov 09 21:39:12 gpu-node-07 systemd[1]: cloud-init[1234]: volume_decrypt: ERROR: AccessDeniedException: User not authorized to use KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01```

emma: We should avoid IP allowlists (AWS KMS IPs aren't stable). Options: 1) allow outbound TLS to `kms.*.amazonaws.com` via our egress proxy, 2) add the KMS VPC endpoints (privatelink) to the allowed list, or 3) carve an exception for the NAT GW's elastic IPs. 1 or 2 are preferable.

ryan: Can the firewall support FQDN-based egress rules today? I thought it was CIDR-only.

security-oncall: Current firewall doesn't support FQDN natively. We're trying to push FQDN allow via the proxy team (squid / proxy-aws) but that's not in this rollout. The safest quick fix is to add the KMS VPC endpoint(s) to the allowlist or exempt the warm pool subnets from the default deny.

anita: Proposed immediate actions: pause rollout, add an allow rule for the KMS VPC endpoint IDs (vpce-xxxx) for usw2 and add NAT GW EIP as fallback. I'll open a hotfix PR to #5123 that adds the exemption.

kevin: If we pause, we should also run a smoke test against a warm pool node: `curl -v https://kms.us-west-2.amazonaws.com` from a job running in the warm pool subnet and try `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://test.blob`. Add to runbook: "verify KMS unwrap + node joins within 5m".

emma: I'll draft the runbook change. Also recommend adding a quick monitoring alert: `gpu.node.decrypt.failures > 0 for 5m` -> page oncall and auto-pause any infra rollout webhook.

security-oncall: I'll hold the rollout for tonight and comment on PR #5123. Do not merge until we have at least one of: (a) VPC endpoint allowlist, (b) NAT GW EIP whitelisted, or (c) confirmed proxy FQDN rule in place.

ryan: Ack. I've tagged the release window as held and notified release-manager. Rollback window scheduled at 22:15 UTC if anything slips. :thumbsup: 

anita: Thanks — applying hold now. I'll push the hotfix PR and ping once it's merged.

kevin: After hotfix, let's add an automated test to CI that boots a minimal gpu node in a sandbox and validates KMS unwrap — prevents regressions from firewall changes.

anita: Agreed. Follow-up tasks created. Will update this thread after PR.

sre-ops-bot: NOTE: follow-up checklist created -> runbook PR #789, hotfix PR #5130, alert rule PR #5141.
